#### Assumptions

- No HRA, 80C, 80D or other deduction is computed. Old regime: only the user-supplied other_deductions total is subtracted. New regime: only the standard deduction applies (employer NPS and similar are out of scope).
- Total income is rounded to the pack's multiple (s.288A convention) and tax to the pack's multiple (s.288B convention): paise ignored, a last figure of 5 or more rounds up.
- Surcharge applies on total income above each band threshold with marginal relief; health and education cess applies on tax plus surcharge.
- Tax year FY2026-27 (derived from as_of): rules must be in effect on 2026-04-01; their staleness is judged as of 2026-10-11.
- Rule values used are not human-verified (UNVERIFIED); check them against the cited sources before relying on them.
- Professional tax and the employee EPF contribution are not computed; they are the user-supplied payroll_deductions (annual total).
- Take-home = gross salary - income tax - payroll_deductions; employer contributions, reimbursements and bonuses not in gross salary are ignored.

#### Assumptions

- Emergency-fund target uses 6 months of essential expenses.
- Benefit estimates are assumptions, not promises; compare all three scenarios rather than relying on one. Losses beyond the stated downside are not modelled.
- The upfront cost is assumed to be paid from the emergency-fund balance; recurring costs come out of the monthly surplus.
- Opportunity cost = what the same cash would earn at the cited low-risk rate (nominal rate/12, monthly compounding, costs paid at the start of each month) minus the cash spent. Low-risk is not no-risk.
- The cited 1-year post office time deposit compounds quarterly; the opportunity cost here uses monthly compounding at rate/12, which slightly overstates it (a cautious bias against spending). PPF compounds annually.
- Payback months are rounded up to whole months; benefits and costs are taken as level each month over the horizon.
- No combined score: each option is judged per criterion and by its gate disposition.
- Life Mentor never executes a purchase, payment, investment or data share; it only analyses and recommends.
